businesses.business: diversified education and media holding company

offering_description.value: Diversified holding company operating education (Kaplan), television broadcasting, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive dealerships and other businesses. It sells educational services to students and institutions, advertising on local TV stations, manufactured products to businesses, and vehicles and home health services to consumers.

primary_products.value: lifting and rigging products; custom-fabricated wood and flooring products; automotive vehicles; advertising airtime; restaurant and entertainment offerings

primary_services.value: higher education and professional training; test preparation; local television broadcasting; home health and hospice care; automotive retail and repair

customer_segment.value: B2C: students, patients and vehicle buyers; B2B: advertisers, universities and employers, industrial and construction customers; B2G: government education and training contracts

end_markets.value: education; broadcast media and advertising; healthcare; manufacturing; automotive retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and training fees, home health and hospice services; advertising: local TV advertising and retransmission fees; product sales: manufactured goods and vehicles

value_chain_position.value: service provider: education, healthcare and broadcasting services to students, patients and advertisers; OEM / manufacturer: makes rigging, flooring and wood products for industrial customers; retailer: sells and services vehicles through dealerships to consumers

geography_served.value: global: Mainly US, with Kaplan education operations in the UK, Singapore, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: education, television broadcasting, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive dealerships, restaurants and other businesses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enrollment, advertising sales and industrial sales teams; online: online courses and degree programs; own locations: campuses, TV stations, car dealerships and restaurants

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC broadcast licenses, education accreditation and financial aid rules, Medicare hospice and home health regulation
